-# generic borrowed-set element clone (`clone_owned`) covers the `Vec`-element case: a
-# borrowed `&T` binder stored into a closed list (`[x, x]` -> `vec![x.clone(), …]`) or
-# a cons head (`[x | xs]` -> `__v.insert(0, x.clone())`) is `.clone()`d. The REST of the
-# owned↔borrow coercion — borrowed `&T` in a VARIANT payload (`Some(x)`), owned-`String`/
-# owned-returning-call arg producers, and the `borrow_value` clone-or-`&` for borrowed
-# args at generic call sites — and parametric-type monomorphization (`Vec(Pair)` ->
-# `Vec<Pair<K, V>>`, see `render_inst` below; the variant-payload clone needs it), plus
+# generic borrowed-set element clone (`clone_owned`) covers a borrowed `&T` binder
+# stored into an owned position: a closed list (`[x, x]` -> `vec![x.clone(), …]`), a
+# cons head (`[x | xs]` -> `__v.insert(0, x.clone())`), or a non-`Result` variant payload
+# (`P(k: a, …)` -> `Pair::P { k: a.clone(), … }`). Parametric-enum monomorphization
+# (ADR-0061) is in for the common case: a parametric sum lowers to `enum Name<K: Clone,
+# …>` (`generics`), and a GENERIC builder's bare parametric return is instantiated with
+# the type's params (`Pair` -> `Pair<K, V>`, via `inst_ret`). The REST — a NON-generic
+# builder's concrete instantiation (`Box` -> `Box<i64>`, inferred from the body) and
+# NESTED/param-position parametric types (`Vec(Pair)` -> `Vec<Pair<K, V>>`, the
+# structured-`Ty` `render_inst` below) — plus owned-`String`/owned-returning-call arg
+# producers, the `borrow_value` clone-or-`&` for borrowed args at generic call sites,
 # maps, String-return coercion, the Elixir text target, and struct *patterns* (a
